title: Class scheme
description: What each display class means, shared by vector and raster display: codes or breaks, labels, groups, counts, unit and status. No colours; the map renderer colours classes by theme. Written by scheme.py and raster.py display (mode values). Readers ignore unknown fields and refuse unknown schema_version values.

field.description: Vector field, or 'band N' for a raster.

method.description: How classes were made: manual, quantile, equal_interval, categories or domain.

breaks.description: Numeric kinds: strictly increasing, one fewer than classes. Lower inclusive, upper exclusive; first/last unbounded.

domain.description: [min, max] of valid values; required for continuous.

classes.description: Ordered classes; id equals the array index (and the class-index raster value). Empty for continuous.

group.description: Legend group heading for categorical schemes.

counts.description: Valid features or pixels per class, same order as classes.

unlisted.description: Categorical: valid values without a listed category.
